mentions.name: Speed of Thought loop
mentions.description: This project implements the author's own loop method, which has already been tested, by wrapping it with a finite state machine (FSM / Stately / XState) to produce a likely-correct loop; a study page documents the speed-of-thought approach.
mentions.source_excerpt: On the other hand I'm working on my own loop. I have the method tested, now I just wrap it with an FSM / Stately / XState to get the likely-correct loop. [2]
mentions.author: csbartus
